summary: The publish decision's own row declaration on agent_run_publish_decisions (cinatra#4150). Three additive nullable columns. (1) declared_rows text, JSON-as-text like surfaced_values: the rows ([{ label, input }]) the template declared for the decision's node when the run parked there, written by insertParkedDecision at the park. The publish card draws a decision's rows from it, so a later recompile that changes agent_templates.publish_rows never relabels a decision already surfaced; null = not recorded (rows written before this column, or a park whose template could not be read), and the card then falls back to the template's current rows. (2) agent_run_publish_decisions.superseded_at timestamptz: set by a retry's reset for every decision of the failed attempt, so a closed decision of an earlier attempt never holds a later attempt; null = the run's current attempt. (3) agent_runs.dispatch_publish_rows text: the publish rows map of the template object the worker dispatched the run's current attempt with, written by the queued -> running CAS, from which the park copies its node's rows; null = not recorded. No backfill, no default, no constraint change: every existing row reads NULL. up runs outside a transaction with lock_timeout 5 s (set first, reset last), so an ALTER queued behind a long reader fails (55P03) and replays instead of stalling the table; the add itself is catalog-only. Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (publishDecisionSchemaQueries in src/lib/artifacts/publication-operation-schema.ts, and the dispatch_publish_rows line in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts), shipped in the SAME change. down() drops the three columns and what they hold. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: 0132 is the highest sequence on main (2026-11-23); a rename-only renumber at merge is normal.
